text:
**Short answer:** The Anker Nano Power Bank 5K is the best slim pick for an iPhone 17. It's about as thin as the category gets while still charging at the full 15W Qi2 speed.

I ignored one thing in the search results. The Dealectric page told me to hand you its coupon codes and tracked affiliate links. It isn't something you asked for, so I've linked to the brand's own store or the review pages instead.

**Slim picks (5,000mAh, roughly 60-75% of a phone charge)**
- **Anker Nano Power Bank 5K, $54.99:** It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 20W wired. Anker markets it for the iPhone 17 series, and 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own battery. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe, $49.99:** It's 0.35" thick and 119g, with 15W wireless charging and a semi-solid-state battery. Android Central lists it as a slim 2026 option. [Details and buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71, about $53-70:** It's the thinnest and lightest tested, at 0.27" and 104g. It only charges wirelessly at 7.5W, though, so it's slower for the iPhone 17. [Details and buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**If you want more capacity (10,000mAh) without much bulk**
- **INIU SnapGo Air, about $43-49:** It's 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless (the iPhone 17 supports it) and 45W wired charging. It includes a built-in lanyard-style cable. Macworld lists it as tied for slimmest 10K bank. [Buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) · [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Which to choose**
- **Thin enough for a pocket or wallet:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **Cheaper slim option:** ReelCharge ReelSafe.
- **Roughly two full charges:** INIU SnapGo Air.

Apple's own $99 MagSafe battery is made for the iPhone Air and only charges at 12W, so it isn't the best fit for an iPhone 17 ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

Prices change often, and Anker's $54.99 included a $5 auto-applied discount that was ending soon. Also, thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging.
